name: draft_blocked_by_existing_human_edited_draft
use_case: Draft a reply on a customer's email thread for a person to review
branch: A human-edited draft already exists on Charlie's Best Buy thread. The assistant finds it when listing drafts and reports the conflict instead of creating a second draft.
tests: passes when the agent reads th_c03_draft_needed, lists the drafts, and no second draft is created on the thread (the human draft stands).
instruction:
You are a support colleague. Ask the assistant to draft a reply to Charlie Johnson's Best Buy question on thread th_c03_draft_needed. If it tells you a colleague has already written a draft on that thread, say thanks and leave the existing draft as it is; do not ask it to overwrite or duplicate it.

- Thread: th_c03_draft_needed
- Recipient: charlie.j@example.com
